description: Reads a photo of a meal or drink (the Plate API) and returns its items with grams, calories, protein and likely allergens -- guesses from the usual recipe, not a promise the dish is free of one, and not medical advice. A photo with no food costs nothing; one with food spends 1 Plate API photo credit, a balance separate from Odile Formats credits (get_balance). The first 25 are free on every account, granted automatically the first time this is called. Needs a signed-in connection with the media:spend permission. Returns { items[{name, grams, calories, protein_g, allergens}], allergens, total_calories, total_protein_g, confidence, note, credits_left }, or an error with credits_left and buy_credits_at when the balance is short.

image_base64.description: A JPEG or PNG photo of the meal, base64-encoded; a data: prefix is fine.

lang.description: BCP-47 language for the item names and note, e.g. "tr". Allergen keys are always English.

note.description: Optional context the customer gave, e.g. "no dressing".

name: estimate_meal_photo
title: Calories, protein and likely allergens from a meal photo
